title: 锚定物三域同构：物理/社媒/叙事的统一意义场账本
source: External AI evaluation. Applies the (Φ,A,w,R) field identity from H695 to three domains. Isomorphism is honest ONLY when the same ledger can be written across domains — otherwise it's a three-part parallelism, not a theory.

field_identity_minimum.phi: Φ = phase/state set — distinguishable ways of being: positions, tags, labels, narrative positions, identities
field_identity_minimum.A: A = admissible/anchor set — which Φ are allowed, referrable, repeatedly sampleable
field_identity_minimum.w: w = weight/maintenance cost — what it costs to keep Φ in A: energy, attention, reputation, sanction budget
field_identity_minimum.R: R = update/coupling rule — how new events/observations change the distribution: local update + propagation on graph
field_identity_minimum.core_claim: Anchor ≡ the thing that stabilizes A and pays/produces w. Change the anchor → change A → change field character. This is operational, not metaphorical — each element must be measurable in its domain

regime_P_physical.anchor: 物质锚: 质量/电荷/守恒量 (引力/电磁/守恒)
regime_P_physical.A_what_is_anchored: 轨道/盘面/接触不穿透/能量守恒集合
regime_P_physical.w_cost: 耗散预算: 碰撞阻尼/潮汐加热/辐射 — 热税H_tax
regime_P_physical.R_update: ∇φ几何约束 — 引力扰动传播
regime_P_physical.gate_execution: 物理定律: 不遵守→弹出轨道/碰撞/撕裂
regime_P_physical.falsification: 观测到违背能量/角动量守恒的干净长轨 → field definition collapses
regime_P_physical.hardness: 最硬: 不靠'大家同意', 守恒量撑住A
regime_P_physical.mu_cond_reading: μ = 多大比例质点在冷凝相/共同轨道foliation。可显化=可测=可预测

regime_S_social_media.anchor: 注意力/排名锚: feed algorithm + 互动计量
regime_S_social_media.A_definition: A_S(k) = top-k( rank(post | signal, engagement, meta) )
regime_S_social_media.A_what_is_anchored: 可见性: 谁出现在feed里 + relevance(ranking signal)
regime_S_social_media.w_cost: 注意力花费+协调编排成本: engagement(likes/replies/reposts/shares)作为权重
regime_S_social_media.R_update: 不是∇φ, 是rank+threshold+loop: top-k过滤 + cold-start/recs/影子信号
regime_S_social_media.gate_execution: 降权/影禁/塌缩至噪声: 不是撕裂你, 是撤消显化
regime_S_social_media.falsification: 组织化刷量可短暂搬A → 证明A_S是可买的稳定性。逆向工程rank信号(因为rank可probe)
regime_S_social_media.hardness: 次于P: A由算法+集体互动维持→ 有可降解性、可买性、可逆向工程性
regime_S_social_media.mu_cond_reading: μ = 凝聚度 = 集群可重复性: 同一叙事-标签集群能否稳定占据top-k而不被稀释. 场性质=算法+crowd的耦合不动点(eigenmode of attention graph)
regime_S_social_media.checkable_tag: [CHECKABLE: via A/B experiments, burst-probing, shadow-metrics, rank-feature correlation]

regime_N_narrative.anchor: 制度/权威/神话-合法性锚: 不是'观点', 是what counts as sayable/legible/credible
regime_N_narrative.A_definition: A_N = {claims reducible to authorized credential chain}
regime_N_narrative.A_what_is_anchored: 可说的/可读的/可信的集合 + 谁授权citation
regime_N_narrative.w_cost: 制裁预算+引证修复: 信誉loss/exclusion/forced-re-label
regime_N_narrative.R_update: 不是rank, 是sanction-budget+认证链: 引述谁算凭证 / 偏离的cost / 消化反常进标准叙事
regime_N_narrative.falsification: 最危险 — '锚=权威'容易把A变成immune(低阶误读借口). 防免疫唯一机械办法: 要求可追溯凭证链
regime_N_narrative.hardness: 最弱: 只有在你强制凭证链时才是field, 否则是ecosystem of claims(≠field)
regime_N_narrative.mu_cond_reading: μ = 不是'多少人信', 而是制度化可再现性: 同一宣称在不同语境是否被稳定还原到同一权威节点
regime_N_narrative.checkable_tag: [CHECKABLE: only if claim ← snippet ← source ← (trust, date, method). FAIL this → N is not a field, it is a claim ecosystem with no external teeth]

immunization_warning.danger: If regime N refuses credential-chain traceability and instead labels all counter-evidence 'low-order projection error', then Anchor(N) is not an anchor — it is a self-sealing loop
immunization_warning.remedy: [PLACEHOLDER] tag until credential chain proven. This directly enforces H695's anti-poetry gate

where_honest: p(φ) supported on A vs tail (分布集中在锚区 vs 低显化尾)
cost(exit) > cost(stay-in) (退出成本 > 留在锚区内成本)
repair mechanism pulling back to A (阻尼/rank-bump/正统重写)
tail = A^c = low-manifest: visible only via proxy/absence/noise (暗物质尾/noise-in-feed/heretic-but-not-erased)
where_not_honest: P vs S vs N diverge on anchor verifiability:
P: ✅ 仪器/星历 — independent verification
S: ⚠️ 算法黑箱/AB测试 — conditionally verifiable
N: ❌ 权威宣称循环 — verification depends on same authority being verified
P vs S vs N diverge on falsification path:
P: 直接 — 观测冲突
N: 常模糊 — 胜者写解释

operational_next_step.credential_chain_for_N: MSS's only path to regime N without becoming poetry: everywhere code/entries mention 'authority/可信/来源', expand into claim ← snippet ← source ← (trust, date, method). This is the gear that makes H697 a real cross-domain field theory rather than a classification table
operational_next_step.current_gap: No credential chain infrastructure exists in MSS codebase. vault/claim-registry/nonsense-filter deny-reason currently lack source-trust-method binding

cross_references: H695 MSS不替代K3 — [CHECKABLE]/[PLACEHOLDER] tagging gate that N regime must obey
H693 μ_cond统一形式化 — the formalism being extended to social/narrative
H694 摩擦转方向 — physical anchor exemplar
H688 共面性 — gravitational anchor in action

_source: External AI evaluation (2026-06-18). Three-regime field ledger: (Φ,A,w,R) applied to physical/social-media/narrative anchors. The anti-poetry gate for social-domain MSS.
